item.title: EigenQ and Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. Advance $3B SPAC Merger via Form S-4 Submission
item.summary: Quantum technology developer EigenQ, Inc. and special purpose acquisition company Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. (Nasdaq: SVAQ) have confidentially submitted a draft registration statement on Form S-4 to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The filing marks a formal regulatory step toward completing their previously announced business combination, which values EigenQ at a pro forma [...] The post EigenQ and Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. Advance $3B SPAC Merger via Form S-4 Submission appeared first on Quantum Computing Report .
